components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--text); color: var(--ground); font: 600 12px/1 'Inter','Noto Sans SC',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e4e4e4; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.description: The compact command-first search control from the top bar.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4 4"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="搜索歌曲、艺人或专辑"><kbd>⌘ K</kbd><button type="button">搜索</button></label>
components.css: .ds-search { width: min(620px,100%); height: 38px; padding-left: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #171717; color: var(--muted); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Inter','Noto Sans SC',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { background: #1e1e1e; } .ds-search svg { width: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: inherit; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--faint); } .ds-search kbd { padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 5px; background: #2b2b2b; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; } .ds-search button { height: 32px; margin-right: 3px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--text); color: var(--ground); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Item

components.css: .ds-track-row { position: relative; min-height: 76px; padding: 8px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--text); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(200px,2fr) minmax(120px,1.2fr) 70px 60px 74px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; font-family: 'Inter','Noto Sans SC',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-track-row.ds-current { background: var(--surface); } .ds-track-row.ds-current::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; width: 2px; height: 36px; background: var(--accent); } .ds-row-index { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--faint); } .ds-track-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-width: 0; } .ds-cover { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 4px; background: #252525; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #d9d9d9; font-size: 11px; } .ds-track-meta > div:last-child { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 5px; } .ds-track-meta strong, .ds-track-meta span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-track-meta strong { font-weight: 500; } .ds-track-meta span, .ds-album, .ds-time { color: var(--muted); } .ds-quality { width: fit-content; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #202020; color: #d6d6d6; font-size: 11px; } .ds-row-action { height: 36px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--control); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; } .ds-row-action:hover { background: var(--raised); } .ds-row-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-player { min-height: 92px; padding: 0 22px; border-top: 1px solid var(--raised); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); display: grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(210px,1fr) minmax(300px,1.35fr) minmax(120px,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 22px; font-family: 'Inter','Noto Sans SC',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-now { display: grid; grid-template-columns:56px minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:12px; min-width:0; } .ds-mini-cover { width:56px; height:56px; border-radius:6px; background:#252525; display:grid; place-items:center; font-weight:600; } .ds-now > div:last-child { min-width:0; display:grid; gap:5px; } .ds-now strong, .ds-now span { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-now strong { font-weight:500; } .ds-now span { color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; } .ds-transport { display:grid; grid-template-columns:36px 38px 36px; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:7px; } .ds-transport button, .ds-lyrics { height:36px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; } .ds-transport .ds-play { width:38px; height:38px; background:var(--text); color:var(--ground); } .ds-transport input { grid-column:1/4; width:100%; accent-color:var(--accent); } .ds-lyrics { justify-self:end; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--control); color:var(--text); } .ds-player button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
Orbit Music is a true-black, flat personal listening workspace. Search, the active library context, real track rows, synchronized lyrics, and playback controls occupy the first useful viewport; there is no promotional hero competing with the music task.

The persistent playback desk is the visual and interaction anchor. White carries ordinary primary actions, signal orange reports live playback and selected status, and album covers provide the richest color. On phones, navigation and lyrics become intentional full-screen surfaces rather than compressed desktop columns.
keyCharacteristics: True-black ground with flat charcoal separation and one-pixel rules.
White primary actions; orange reserved for playback and state.
Real music content and cover art carry visual identity.
Persistent player across desktop, tablet, and phone.
Search-first composition with honest empty, loading, and error states.
Full-screen mobile navigation and lyrics with 44px primary touch targets.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Orange reports playback or state; it never becomes a large background, gradient, glow, or decorative wash.

rules.name: The Cover Art Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Keep application chrome achromatic so real album covers remain the richest color on screen.

rules.name: The Metadata Steps Back Rule
rules.body: Track identity leads; artist, album, duration, source, and helper copy recede through muted or faint text.

rules.name: The Interface Speaks Briefly Rule
rules.body: Use short, literal labels and status messages; typography clarifies work rather than selling the product.

rules.name: The First Viewport Works Rule
rules.body: Search, navigation, the list or empty state, and the playback desk must be immediately usable without scrolling past promotional content.

rules.name: The Flat Means Flat Rule
rules.body: Do not add box shadows, glass effects, gradients, or glow; use fill, rule, and visibility changes to communicate layers.

rules.name: The Pill Is a Control Rule
rules.body: Pills identify actionable controls, filters, range-adjacent tools, and transient feedback; content rows and page regions remain rectilinear.

dos: Do keep search, playback, lyrics, and library actions visible and immediate.
Do let album covers and real music metadata provide visual richness.
Do keep orange scarce and tied to live playback or explicit state.
Do preserve 44px mobile actions, visible focus, inert off-canvas surfaces, and focus return.
Do collapse secondary metadata before compressing track identity or playback.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences for sheets, lyrics, and transient feedback.
donts: Don't add a poster-style hero, campaign copy, decorative equalizer, or cassette illustration.
Don't introduce gradients, glass, glow, ambient orange, or ornamental shadows.
Don't fabricate recommendations, testimonials, audience metrics, or listening statistics.
Don't use orange for ordinary primary buttons when white already communicates action.
Don't treat the phone as a squeezed desktop table.
Don't hide essential playback or library actions behind undersized targets.
